771120102.text: Don't worry about me. Actually, I should say that I feel very good right now, because I saw Doctor Moreau...

771120103.text: I saw him, and he even praised me. He said he could see that I am working really hard to get home with help from both of you.

771120104.text: He said I was amazing, and that I could turn into part of the Perfect Tree too. And I... I could feel mama too... Even though her hug felt a bit different...

771120105.text: But I know that mama was there.

771120106.text: Huh? Doctor Moreau? Nastya's mom? But there's no one here except Nastya!

771120107.text: You can't see them, Paimonka. You have to be family to feel them...

771120108.text: Because... Ah, because... The Perfect Tree is a life that transcends all time and all life. It is... eternity.

771120109.text: Thank you. Nastya is no longer alone... Nastya is "us." And now, or perhaps then too, Nastya has always been part of "us."

771120110.text: It is only at this very moment that she has returned to our embrace. On the level of the eternal, all is connected. Thank you for your help, especially you...

771120111.text: #Descender, the fourth, one half of the twins, and now the one who stands unique in {M#his}{F#her} position.

771120114.speakerName: Thing That Used to be Nastya
771120114.text: We have had countless names, though words like "before" and "past" no longer hold any meaning for us. But I am the thing you seek or pursue. The thing. That person.

771120115.speakerName: Thing That Used to be Nastya
771120115.text: For your ease of understanding, you may call me Koshchei or Doctor Moreau. There is no real difference between the two. Especially now, less than ever.

771120116.text: Oh, so you're the baddie in this story!

771120117.text: We want Goggles' power back! And Nastya, too! You're not allowed to use Nastya's body like that!

771120118.speakerName: Thing That Used to be Nastya
771120118.text: ...The Eye of Graeae, or "Primordial Human." The return of its power was a thing that was bound to happen eventually. But fate will take a turn. I, or we, had originally thought...

771120119.speakerName: Thing That Used to be Nastya
771120119.text: That the one who would appear here would be someone else — Aksinya. But now, you have been chosen to take her place and do what she was meant to do.

771120120.speakerName: Thing That Used to be Nastya
771120120.text: Take it. The ritual is already complete. I, or we, have no use for that power anymore, for we are already eternal. We are a life that is, in concept, infinitely close to eternity.

771120121.speakerName: Thing That Used to be Nastya
771120121.text: Even this brief moment of speech between us will not matter. Across all eternity, all words will lose their meaning. Everything will lose its meaning.

771120122.speakerName: Thing That Used to be Nastya
771120122.text: Ah, but... O everlasting dream, everlasting dream. A courtyard devoid of meaning and therefore entirely without suffering... For what reason did I seek eternity? Was it for... for...

771120123.text: You have forgotten what you wanted.

771120124.speakerName: Thing That Used to be Nastya

771120125.speakerName: Thing That Used to be Nastya
771120125.text: O Eternity, that cold and merciless far shore, where even the fiercest love cannot reach.

771120126.speakerName: Thing That Used to be Nastya

771120127.speakerName: Thing That Used to be Nastya
771120127.text: But... all of this shall still end in a way no one wishes to see...

771120129.speakerName: Thing That Used to be Nastya
771120129.text: You shall come to understand. At the very end, in the very beginning, it was your design, your choice. You chose the Descender. Is this be your final struggle, or merely a coincidence of fate...?

771120130.speakerName: Thing That Used to be Nastya
771120130.text: Such brief suffering. I shall return, return to among "us." Nastya, you still have a little time before you become "us."

771120131.speakerName: Thing That Used to be Nastya
771120131.text: Go say goodbye to them. Though in the end, or at the end of time, after annihilation, we shall all become the same thing in any case.

771120132.text: Um... Okay. I'll take a minute to do that.

771120134.text: #Paimonka, {M#Big Brother}{F#Big Sister} {NICKNAME}, thank you for bringing me home.

771120135.text: Now I can become part of the Perfect Tree. I can be just like everybody else, and be with my mama again...

771120136.text: But Nastya, if you turn into the Perfect Tree, we won't be able to play together anymore. Or, uh, run around in the woods, or eat yummy food together.

771120137.text: That's okay, Paimonka. It'd be so awesome if I could do all that, yes, but there's something more important I have to do.

subQuests.subQuestName: Obtain a part of the Eye of Graeae's body

771120202.text: I'm guessing it's a part of my power that my body has coalesced into this form... like some kind of crystal. Probably because it might not be a very pleasant sight if you have to carry my entire body around otherwise.

771120203.text: Huh, you're probably right. We'll put it away for now then...

771120204.text: Oh, right... Zala. That huge firebird.. Don't people say that firebirds can come back to life again and again?

771120205.text: ...Indeed. And since that creature is wholly a bio-alchemical creation, it probably does not rely on my power for its core.

771120206.text: Then.. then what if it decides there's nothing left here to protect and gets super-duper mad? What if it decides to go off and destroy everything???

771120207.text: That is a real possibility. Man-made monsters generally do not possess a very high level of intelligence...

771120208.text: No, no, we have to head out and make sure that doesn't happen!

771120209.text: ...So. You chose to merge "it" with the plants after all, Koshchei.

771120210.text: O firebird, firebird... Oh how you sing in the night, dance in a palace of glass-like ice and snow, then bow your head in song to feast upon the golden fruit.

771120211.text: Ah, you're here. Are you worried it might revive again? I've made a few small adjustments. Its body will soon break down and disintegrate.

771120212.text: Ultimately, if a man-made monster cannot transcend all things, it is no more than the body of an ordinary monster.

771120213.text: Oh, thank you, thank you... That's a huge help!

771120214.text: Uh, hold on... who are you again?

771120215.text: Oh, that's right. Though I already know who you are, I suppose I have yet to introduce myself to you...

771120216.text: I am but a lowly "Royal Jester" who once served His Majesty, the late Belyi Tsar. My name, insignificant as it is, is Aksinya.

771120218.text: Yes. Does that serve to refresh your memory?

771120219.text: Izmaylo is always complaining that my introductions are far too humble. But personally? I just see it as a deliberate choice of style.

771120221.text: Well, that happens to be the name of the person who built the mechanism you're residing in right now, after all.

771120222.text: You... are the one who made Goggles?

771120224.text: Haha, so you see, "Goggles" belongs to me. Do be good and return it now, you little thieves!

771120226.text: I'm only teasing. Feel free to keep "him" with you.

771120227.text: In that grand design, it was also I who was supposed to obtain the Eye of Graeae along with the will inside it. But since "he" has made "his" choice...

771120228.text: I believe in the Eye of Graeae, and I also believe in you, the ones "he" has chosen.

771120229.text: That's enough of an introduction. Our goal is the same... to help the will inside the Eye of Graeae find its body and reclaim its power.

771120230.text: That is what you want, isn't it?

771120232.text: Then we shall cross paths again on the journey ahead. Ah, it is almost time.

771120234.text: "The fallen leaves rustle at our feet, as winter begins to lay down its offerings"...

771120235.text: ...It's almost time, everyone. Out in the fields, the last blooming flower is about to wither.

771120236.text: Hey, hold on, hold on!!! We still have so many questions——

771120237.text: And she's gone... just like that. Hmph, what a strange lady! Goggles, how are you doing? Did seeing her remind you of anything at all?

771120238.text: A few things. But they're... only vague impressions for now. It was her, along with Koshchei and two other people who created me. That was at...

771120240.text: That is all I can remember for now.

771120242.text: That's alright. She did say we'll see her again later anyway... So, when we do, we'll just make her tell us everything!

771120401.text: So I'm back here again... It looks just like before, except that seed looks like it's about to sprout, and new leaves are also growing...

771120402.text: My little bed... is now being used by another life... My blanket... My pillow, and my toys...

771120403.text: It doesn’t feel like my little corner anymore? But... this feels so strange. Mama is already here beside me, so why do I still miss it..?.

771120404.text: I can feel mama's hand stroking my hair. It hasn't turned into beautiful leaves and branches yet, but mama loves me all the same... "Good children go to sleep early," she says...

771120405.text: (Is that Nastya? I don't know if there's a way we can talk to her, though...)
